text.5337426d22a32230f5be: 35% is a normalized mature EBIT margin. The base case also resets starting EBIT to 35% of reported revenue, so the model does not take ten years to fade from FY2026’s extraordinary 74.6% margin.

text.4a0dac429dd409ea6251: 0.8x requires $1.25 of net reinvestment per extra $1 of sales. Fabs, advanced packaging and process transitions require capital across the cycle; the ratio is not gross capex divided by current revenue.
text.14ba316f9b28280d4e3a: 12% allows a modest technology/industry-structure advantage while avoiding a perpetual scarcity return on memory capacity.
text.d8c54e82a83d7a7775f0: 11.0% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 1.4, 10% target debt and a 1.5-point debt spread reflect cyclical memory pricing and capital intensity even after unusually strong current cash generation.
